purpose: Routing guide only. A source becomes evidence only after a reviewed connector publishes a valid immutable vintage.
selection_order: Free primary authority with lawful machine-readable access
Free primary authority with an operator-supplied official file
Licensed Capital IQ export supplied by an entitled user
Refuse to rate when none of those routes can meet the profile contract

capital_iq.rule: Never scrape a signed-in page or store credentials. Export CSV under the user's entitlement, ingest it through the attested manual connector path, and preserve redistribution restrictions.

authorities.provider: U.S. Energy Information Administration
Federal Energy Regulatory Commission
U.S. Department of Energy natural-gas import/export reports
ENTSOG Transparency Platform and primary transmission operators

rules.capital_iq_fallback: A licensed export may fill one leg, but the connector must preserve installed and commissioned LNG capacity, terminal outages, pipeline technical and available capacity, nominations, physical flows, and restriction notices as separate dated fields.

authorities.provider: U.S. Energy Information Administration petroleum and biofuels data
USDA NASS Grain Crushings and Co-Products Production
USDA NASS Fats and Oils: Oilseed Crushings, Production, Consumption and Stocks

rules.capital_iq_fallback: A licensed export may fill one exact parent only. Keep ethanol output and stocks, corn grind, soybean-oil biofuel use, feedstock share, margin inputs, units, periods and release vintages as separate fields; policy and fuel prices cannot substitute for realised physical use.

authorities.provider: National Development and Reform Commission of China
National Energy Administration of China
Yunnan provincial energy authorities
China Southern Power Grid and primary aluminium producers

rules.capital_iq_fallback: A licensed capacity or output series is a cross-check only. Decision-grade evidence must retain the dated capacity cap, hydro availability, grid curtailment instruction, affected smelting capacity, geography and primary publisher; estimates cannot replace those releases.

authorities.provider: London Metal Exchange Aluminium Commitments of Traders

rules.capital_iq_fallback: Not permitted for this exchange-specific series. Preserve the LME Aluminium contract, investment-fund long and short positions, open interest, position date, publication date and revised report; if three lawful years cannot be obtained, leave the series unavailable.

authorities.provider: Shanghai Futures Exchange Aluminium Daily Ranking

rules.capital_iq_fallback: Not permitted for this exchange-specific series. Preserve SHFE product code AL, contract month, ranked member long and short positions, changes, total open interest, trade date and publication date; LME or CFTC data cannot substitute, and missing lawful history remains unavailable.

authorities.provider: Issuing government, regulator, ministry, customs authority, or producer group

rules.capital_iq_fallback: Use dated primary-source event records or news linked to the original notice; never treat an unsourced headline as the policy fact.

authorities.provider: EIA, USDA, USGS, official FX/rate publishers, and relevant exchanges

rules.capital_iq_fallback: Use Capital IQ only for licensed raw input series. Keep formulas, units, assumptions, and parent vintage IDs in the derived record.

authorities.provider: U.S. Commodity Futures Trading Commission
Relevant futures exchange

rules.capital_iq_fallback: Use a licensed positioning export only when the exchange/regulator does not publish the required contract or history.

authorities.provider: Fund issuer daily holdings/creation files

rules.capital_iq_fallback: Not permitted for these issuer-only series. If lawful issuer or sponsor history cannot supply the defined series, leave it manual or unavailable.

authorities.provider: International Monetary Fund Data
Reporting central bank or monetary authority

rules.capital_iq_fallback: Use a licensed official-reserves series only when its country coverage, unit, reporting lag, and revisions are preserved in each sealed vintage.

authorities.provider: Ghana Cocoa Board Cocoa Health and Extension Division
Cote d'Ivoire Conseil du Cafe-Cacao swollen-shoot programme

rules.capital_iq_fallback: Not permitted for the required surveillance series. Preserve disease name, affected area or tree count, survey geography, observation period, publication date, treatment status and regulator; weather, production estimates and old undated incidence cannot substitute for a current regional observation.

authorities.provider: NOAA Climate Prediction Center
USDA National Agricultural Statistics Service

rules.capital_iq_fallback: Capital IQ may fill a market series, but it does not replace NOAA/USDA weather and crop observations when those are required.

authorities.provider: U.S. Treasury
Federal Reserve / FRED

rules.capital_iq_fallback: Use Capital IQ only as an explicit fallback provider with the same series definition and units.

authorities.provider: USDA Foreign Agricultural Service

rules.capital_iq_fallback: A licensed export is only a fallback; keep USDA gross sales, net sales, reductions/adjustments, shipments, destination, market year and release date as separate fields.

authorities.provider: European Commission cereals customs surveillance
Canadian Grain Commission grain export statistics
Australian Bureau of Statistics International Trade in Goods
Argentina INDEC foreign-trade database
UN Comtrade official reporter customs submissions

rules.capital_iq_fallback: Not permitted for this primary trade-flow series. Keep Russia, the EU, Canada, Australia and Argentina as separate reporters with wheat HS code, quantity, unit, destination, shipment month, release date and revision status; USDA U.S. export sales or forecast balances cannot substitute, and every missing origin must remain explicit.

authorities.provider: CME Group CBOT soybean, soybean-meal, and soybean-oil settlements

rules.capital_iq_fallback: A licensed export may supply the exact CME settlement legs, but all three contracts must use aligned months and preserve the stated conversion yields, fees, units, formulas, and parent vintage IDs.

authorities.provider: National Bureau of Statistics of China
General Administration of Customs of China

rules.capital_iq_fallback: Use a dated Capital IQ export when the official release is not lawfully machine-readable; retain the official series name and release period.

authorities.provider: OECD Data Explorer
World Bank Data

rules.capital_iq_fallback: Use a licensed, named macro series only if it preserves the same definition and release vintage.

authorities.provider: Relevant central bank, Federal Reserve, BIS, or IMF

rules.capital_iq_fallback: Use a licensed spot/real-effective FX series with the currency pair, fixing time, and rate convention stated.

authorities.provider: CME Group COMEX official inventory and delivery reports

rules.capital_iq_fallback: Not permitted for this CME-only series. If no stable lawful machine route exists, ingest the dated CME official report manually or leave the series unavailable.

authorities.provider: Relevant futures/physical exchange or benchmark administrator

rules.capital_iq_fallback: Capital IQ is the normal licensed fallback for curves and cash series. Export all required contracts/tenors together so curve math is point-in-time consistent.

authorities.provider: International Energy Agency Oil Market Report
OECD Data Explorer
U.S. Energy Information Administration

rules.capital_iq_fallback: A licensed export may supply one exact inventory or demand parent only. Days cover must retain the OECD/global geography, demand denominator, unit, period and release vintage; US stocks cannot substitute.

authorities.provider: International Cocoa Organization
European Cocoa Association
National Confectioners Association
Cocoa Association of Asia

rules.capital_iq_fallback: Not permitted for the required primary grindings series. Preserve each region, quarter, revision and publisher; otherwise leave the series unavailable.

authorities.provider: Gas Infrastructure Europe AGSI+

rules.capital_iq_fallback: A licensed series may be a cross-check only. The decision-grade series must preserve AGSI+ working gas, technical capacity, fill percentage, geography, gas day and retrieval vintage.

authorities.provider: EIA for energy; USDA for crops; exchange/industry body for metals and softs
USDA Economics, Statistics, and Market Information System

rules.capital_iq_fallback: Use a dated licensed balance/inventory export only when the primary publisher route is unavailable. Preserve revisions as new vintages.

authorities.provider: USDA FAS, NASS, WAOB, and the relevant national crop authority
USDA NASS Quick Stats

rules.capital_iq_fallback: Use a licensed export only for the exact crop/country/marketing-year series; do not mix crop years or units.

authorities.provider: U.S. Energy Information Administration
OPEC official publications

rules.capital_iq_fallback: Use Capital IQ for licensed global or non-public histories, with geography, unit, frequency, and release period fixed in the connector contract.

authorities.provider: U.S. Geological Survey
Relevant national geological survey or recognized commodity study group

rules.capital_iq_fallback: Use a licensed industry series when the primary body restricts machine access; label estimates and keep each release vintage.

authorities.provider: Commodity regulator, exchange, ministry, statistical agency, or recognized industry body

rules.capital_iq_fallback: If no lawful primary route exists, use a licensed Capital IQ CSV export. If neither can satisfy the exact profile definition, leave the series unavailable.
